answer: The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the prism funding graph is rebuilt from the forge history every epoch. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 343 bonds yet holds one position, and the lantern report publishes the merged exposure. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 343 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
